purpose: Teach: 立たさ/公布/蜂起/死傷/迎撃/内包/輩出/わいせつ

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療従事者が窮地に立たされた感染期を医療チームで振り返ります
lines.en: Ren — when healthcare workers faced those critical shortages during the infection surge, we reviewed it together as a medical team.
lines.style: Steady, measured opening. Professional but not distant. Voice carries the weight of that period. Slight pause before 'medical team' — acknowledgment of shared burden.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、新医療基準の公布を医療チームで遵守しております
lines.en: Yes. We've been adhering to the new medical protocols as a team across the hospital.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Calm certainty. No hesitation — this is established fact. Quiet pride in the consistency. Not defensive, just factual.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療従事者の蜂起的なストライキ運動を、貴院、ご経験ですか、先生
lines.en: Did your hospital experience those kinds of labor actions from healthcare workers, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not probing. Respectful but not deferential. Lean slightly forward with the question. The tone of someone who wants to understand what she lived through.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、災害現場での死傷者対応を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes. Our team handled the casualty response in disaster situations. That's part of what we do.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact. No flourish. Understated competence. The way someone speaks about difficult work they've simply accepted as necessary.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感染症迎撃チームを、貴院、立ち上げられたんですね、先生
lines.en: So you did set up an infection response team at your hospital, didn't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Gentle recognition, not interrogation. Ren piecing something together aloud. Respectful confirmation. The tone of realizing something about someone you're coming to understand.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、薬の中に内包される副作用を医療チームで研究しております
lines.en: Yes. We research the side effects inherent in medications. That's ongoing work across the team.
lines.style: Steady continuation. Low energy but not resigned. Factual. The slight tiredness of important work that doesn't end. Breath under the words, not above them.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院は名医を多く輩出されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital has produced so many excellent doctors, hasn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine admiration. Not flattery — observation. Warm and respectful. A small acknowledgment of something he's noticed about her institution and, by extension, about her.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、わいせつ被害の医療ケアを医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes. We provide medical care to survivors of sexual assault. That's another responsibility our team carries.
lines.style: Unflinching and clear. No softening, no apology. The composure of someone who has chosen to do difficult work and will not diminish it. Quiet dignity in the statement.
